reading_standard: Read by the analyst (Claude) on 2026-10-15, after the label phase and before any S2, R2 or behavioural number. A unit is NAMED_BY_CONTEXT when >= 8 of the 12 contexts of one tail share one specific construction that a mechanical rule could be written for. Broad, high-base-rate categories ('a subordinate clause', 'a clause onset', 'a noun phrase') do not count. Twins (section 5) are read as one family: if either member meets the standard on its own, or the pooled matching tails reach >= 16/24, both members get the reading (the conservative direction). The 'evidence' field gives the counts; for 'none' it records any partial pattern seen.
